- `bash infra/crossplane/functions/__tests__/functions_test.sh` exits 0 (6 functions at exact spec versions).
- `bash infra/crossplane/environment-configs/__tests__/env_test.sh` exits 0 (env-dev/staging/prod with required keys).
- `bash infra/crossplane/xrds/core/__tests__/core_xrds_test.sh` exits 0 (9 Bundle A XRDs).
- `bash infra/crossplane/xrds/obs-identity/__tests__/obs_xrds_test.sh` exits 0 (4 Bundle B XRDs).
- `bash infra/crossplane/xrds/schema-gov/__tests__/schema_xrds_test.sh` exits 0 (11 Bundle C XRDs).
- `bash infra/crossplane/xrds/cloud-bootstrap/__tests__/bootstrap_xrds_test.sh` exits 0 (4 Bundle D XRDs).
- `bash infra/crossplane/compositions/__tests__/compositions_test.sh` exits 0 (35 Compositions; PG dev claim renders a valid CNPG Cluster).
- `bash infra/crossplane/__tests__/parent_kustomization_test.sh` exits 0 (`kustomize build infra/crossplane` emits ≥ 90 documents).
- `bash infra/crossplane/tests/__tests__/chainsaw_runs_test.sh` exits 0 (chainsaw render fixtures pass for PG, Kafka, R2 bucket; `kcl vet` passes on the protocol-filter KCL).
- `.github/workflows/pr.yml` has a `xp-validate` job invoked on every PR commit, and `task ci:per-commit` walks all C1..C8 gates green against the C8 SHA.
- All cumulative gates from C1..C7 (`docs-lint`, `cli-test`, `contracts`, `nx-affected`, `polyglot-typecheck`, `container-smoke`, `helm-validate`, `argo-validate`) remain green.
- No file under `infra/crossplane/` uses any provider/function/chart version that diverges from spec §8.1, §8.2, or §8.4.

## Phase 9 — Crossplane claims (per env) (Commit 9)

This commit delivers the per-environment Crossplane claim manifests under `infra/crossplane/claims/{dev,staging,prod}/` for the three Day-1 reference apps (`go-hello`, `py-hello`, `rs-hello`). Each app gets a `PostgresClusterClaim`, `RedisClusterClaim`, `ServiceObservabilityClaim`, and `KeycloakClientClaim`. The three apps share a `KafkaTopicClaim` for `user.events.v1` and a `BucketClaim` for shared assets per env. Profile sizing is injected by `function-environment-configs` (already wired in Phase 8 — Commit 8), so claims only carry `env`, `size`, and contract-specific fields. CI adds the `xp-claims` gate (`yq` schema parse + `crossplane beta render` against the C8 compositions). This commit depends on Phase 8 (Commit 8) — all referenced XRDs and Compositions (`xpostgrescluster-cnpg-singlenode`, `xrediscluster-kubeblocks-small`, `xkafkatopic-strimzi`, `xbucket-azureblob`, `xserviceobservability-default`, `xkeycloakclient-default`) plus the three `EnvironmentConfig` objects (`env-dev`, `env-staging`, `env-prod`) must already exist on disk and validate.

```markdown
<!-- infra/crossplane/claims/README.md -->

# Crossplane Claims (per env)

Per-environment XR claim manifests for the Day-1 reference apps
(`go-hello`, `py-hello`, `rs-hello`).

Layout:

- `dev/` — claims rendered against `EnvironmentConfig/env-dev` (size `xs`)
- `staging/` — claims rendered against `EnvironmentConfig/env-staging` (size `s`)
- `prod/` — claims rendered against `EnvironmentConfig/env-prod` (size `m`)

Per app:

- `<app>-pg.yaml` — `PostgresClusterClaim` (XPostgresCluster)
- `<app>-redis.yaml` — `RedisClusterClaim` (XRedisCluster)
- `<app>-obs.yaml` — `ServiceObservabilityClaim` (XServiceObservability)
- `<app>-keycloak.yaml` — `KeycloakClientClaim` (XKeycloakClient)

Shared:

- `shared-topics.yaml` — one `KafkaTopicClaim` for `user.events.v1`
- `shared-bucket.yaml` — one `BucketClaim` for shared assets

Sizing is injected by `function-environment-configs` from Phase 8.
Claims do not hard-code replica/storage values — only `env`, `size`,
and contract-level fields.

See spec Section 8 (claims layout) and Section 12 (reference apps).
```

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "https://pn.cloud/schemas/claim-envelope.schema.json",
  "title": "Crossplane Claim Envelope",
  "type": "object",
  "required": ["apiVersion", "kind", "metadata", "spec"],
  "properties": {
    "apiVersion": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^pn\\.cloud/v1alpha1$"
    },
    "kind": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "PostgresClusterClaim",
        "RedisClusterClaim",
        "KafkaTopicClaim",
        "BucketClaim",
        "ServiceObservabilityClaim",
        "KeycloakClientClaim"
      ]
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "required": ["name", "namespace"],
      "properties": {
        "name": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 },
        "namespace": { "type": "string", "enum": ["dev", "staging", "prod"] }
      }
    },
    "spec": {
      "type": "object",
      "required": ["env"],
      "properties": {
        "env": { "type": "string", "enum": ["dev", "staging", "prod"] },
        "size": { "type": "string", "enum": ["xs", "s", "m", "l"] }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```bash
cat > infra/crossplane/claims/tests/parse_claims.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Parse every YAML claim under infra/crossplane/claims/{dev,staging,prod}
# and validate it against claim-envelope.schema.json.
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="${1:-infra/crossplane/claims}"
SCHEMA="infra/crossplane/claims/schemas/claim-envelope.schema.json"

if ! command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "ERROR: yq not installed (need mikefarah/yq v4)" >&2
  exit 2
fi
if ! command -v ajv >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "ERROR: ajv-cli not installed (npm i -g ajv-cli)" >&2
  exit 2
fi

fail=0
for env in dev staging prod; do
  envdir="${ROOT}/${env}"
  [ -d "${envdir}" ] || continue
  while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
    if ! yq eval '.' "${f}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "PARSE FAIL: ${f}" >&2
      fail=1
      continue
    fi
    tmp=$(mktemp --suffix=.json)
    yq eval -o=json '.' "${f}" > "${tmp}"
    if ! ajv validate -s "${SCHEMA}" -d "${tmp}" --strict=false >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "SCHEMA FAIL: ${f}" >&2
      ajv validate -s "${SCHEMA}" -d "${tmp}" --strict=false || true
      fail=1
    fi
    rm -f "${tmp}"
  done < <(find "${envdir}" -maxdepth 1 -name '*.yaml' ! -name 'kustomization.yaml' -print0)
done
exit "${fail}"
EOF
chmod +x infra/crossplane/claims/tests/parse_claims.sh
```

```yaml
# infra/crossplane/claims/dev/shared-topics.yaml
apiVersion: pn.cloud/v1alpha1
kind: KafkaTopicClaim
metadata:
  name: user-events-v1
  namespace: dev
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/component: kafka-topic
    pn.cloud/shared: 'true'
spec:
  env: dev
  cluster: shared
  topic: user.events.v1
  partitions: 1
  replicas: 1
  retentionMs: 86400000
  cleanupPolicy: delete
  config:
    min.insync.replicas: '1'
    compression.type: 'producer'
  compositionSelector:
    matchLabels:
      pn.cloud/variant: strimzi
```

```yaml
# infra/crossplane/claims/dev/go-hello-obs.yaml
apiVersion: pn.cloud/v1alpha1
kind: ServiceObservabilityClaim
metadata:
  name: go-hello
  namespace: dev
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: go-hello
    app.kubernetes.io/component: observability
spec:
  env: dev
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: go-hello
  metricsPath: /metrics
  metricsPort: 9090
  scrapeInterval: 30s
  slos:
    - name: availability
      sli: 'sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="go-hello",status!~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="go-hello"}[5m]))'
      objective: 0.99
      window: 30d
    - name: latency-p99
      sli: 'histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="go-hello"}[5m])) by (le))'
      objective: 0.5
      window: 30d
    - name: error-rate
      sli: 'sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="go-hello",status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="go-hello"}[5m]))'
      objective: 0.01
      window: 30d
  dashboardJSON:
    sourceRef:
      kind: ConfigMap
      name: go-hello-dashboard
      key: dashboard.json
  alertingTo: null
  compositionSelector:
    matchLabels:
      pn.cloud/variant: default
```

```bash
cat > infra/crossplane/claims/tests/test_keycloak_claims.bats <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bats

APPS="go-hello py-hello rs-hello"

@test "every env+app has a KeycloakClientClaim with realm=platform" {
  for env in dev staging prod; do
    for app in $APPS; do
      f="infra/crossplane/claims/${env}/${app}-keycloak.yaml"
      [ -f "${f}" ]
      [ "$(yq eval '.kind' "${f}")" = "KeycloakClientClaim" ]
      [ "$(yq eval '.spec.realm' "${f}")" = "platform" ]
    done
  done
}

@test "clientId equals <app>-<env>" {
  for env in dev staging prod; do
    for app in $APPS; do
      f="infra/crossplane/claims/${env}/${app}-keycloak.yaml"
      [ "$(yq eval '.spec.clientId' "${f}")" = "${app}-${env}" ]
    done
  done
}

@test "every redirectUri uses the env-scoped host" {
  for env in dev staging prod; do
    for app in $APPS; do
      f="infra/crossplane/claims/${env}/${app}-keycloak.yaml"
      first=$(yq eval '.spec.redirectUris[0]' "${f}")
      case "${env}" in
        dev)     expected="http://${app}.localtest.me/callback" ;;
        staging) expected="https://${app}.staging.pn.cloud/callback" ;;
        prod)    expected="https://${app}.pn.cloud/callback" ;;
      esac
      [ "${first}" = "${expected}" ]
    done
  done
}

@test "every keycloak claim requests openid+profile+email scopes" {
  for env in dev staging prod; do
    for app in $APPS; do
      f="infra/crossplane/claims/${env}/${app}-keycloak.yaml"
      scopes=$(yq eval '.spec.scopes | join(",")' "${f}")
      [ "${scopes}" = "openid,profile,email" ]
    done
  done
}

@test "every env kustomization references three keycloak claims" {
  for env in dev staging prod; do
    for app in $APPS; do
      grep -q "^  - ${app}-keycloak.yaml$" "infra/crossplane/claims/${env}/kustomization.yaml"
    done
  done
}

@test "parse_claims.sh accepts keycloak claims" {
  bash infra/crossplane/claims/tests/parse_claims.sh
}
EOF
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Create keycloak claims and update kustomizations**

```yaml
# infra/crossplane/claims/dev/go-hello-keycloak.yaml
apiVersion: pn.cloud/v1alpha1
kind: KeycloakClientClaim
metadata:
  name: go-hello
  namespace: dev
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: go-hello
    app.kubernetes.io/component: identity
spec:
  env: dev
  realm: platform
  clientId: go-hello-dev
  redirectUris:
    - http://go-hello.localtest.me/callback
  scopes:
    - openid
    - profile
    - email
  groupMappers:
    - { group: dev-engineers, claim: groups }
  serviceAccount:
    enabled: false
    roles: []
  connectionSecret: go-hello-oidc-conn
  compositionSelector:
    matchLabels:
      pn.cloud/variant: default
```

or if `crossplane` is not on PATH, all 3 are skipped — install via `task tools:install:crossplane` before re-running.

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement render harness**

```bash
cat > infra/crossplane/claims/tests/render_all.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Render every claim under infra/crossplane/claims/{dev,staging,prod}
# against Phase-8 compositions + environment-configs + functions.
#
# Usage:
#   render_all.sh                          # render all, exit non-zero on first failure
#   render_all.sh --print dev/<file>.yaml  # print rendered output for one claim
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="infra/crossplane"
CLAIMS="${ROOT}/claims"
COMPOSITIONS="${ROOT}/compositions"
FUNCTIONS="${ROOT}/functions"
ENV_CONFIGS="${ROOT}/environment-configs"

if ! command -v crossplane >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "ERROR: crossplane CLI not installed" >&2
  exit 2
fi

print_one=""
if [[ "${1:-}" == "--print" ]]; then
  print_one="${2:?--print requires a relative claim path}"
fi

render_one() {
  local claim="$1"
  local env_name
  env_name=$(yq eval '.metadata.namespace' "${claim}")
  local env_cfg="${ENV_CONFIGS}/env-${env_name}.yaml"

  if [[ ! -f "${env_cfg}" ]]; then
    echo "MISSING env-config: ${env_cfg} for ${claim}" >&2
    return 1
  fi

  crossplane beta render \
    "${claim}" \
    "${COMPOSITIONS}" \
    "${FUNCTIONS}" \
    --extra-resources "${env_cfg}"
}

if [[ -n "${print_one}" ]]; then
  render_one "${CLAIMS}/${print_one}"
  exit 0
fi

fail=0
for env in dev staging prod; do
  while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
    if ! render_one "${f}" >/dev/null; then
      echo "RENDER FAIL: ${f}" >&2
      fail=1
    fi
  done < <(find "${CLAIMS}/${env}" -maxdepth 1 -name '*.yaml' ! -name 'kustomization.yaml' -print0)
done
exit "${fail}"
EOF
chmod +x infra/crossplane/claims/tests/render_all.sh
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement workflow + register required job in pr.yml**

```yaml
# .github/workflows/xp-claims.yml
name: xp-claims
on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'infra/crossplane/claims/**'
      - 'infra/crossplane/xrds/**'
      - 'infra/crossplane/compositions/**'
      - 'infra/crossplane/functions/**'
      - 'infra/crossplane/environment-configs/**'
      - '.github/workflows/xp-claims.yml'
  workflow_call: {}

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  xp-claims:
    name: Crossplane claim parse + render
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install yq (mikefarah v4)
        uses: mikefarah/yq-action@v4

      - name: Verify yq is on PATH
        run: yq --version

      - name: Install Node.js for ajv-cli
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install ajv-cli
        run: npm install -g ajv-cli@5

      - name: Install crossplane CLI v1.17.3
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crossplane/crossplane/release-1.17/install.sh \
            | XP_CHANNEL=stable XP_VERSION=v1.17.3 sh
          sudo install -m 0755 crossplane /usr/local/bin/crossplane
          crossplane version

      - name: Install bats
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y bats

      - name: Parse claims (yq + JSON Schema)
        run: bash infra/crossplane/claims/tests/parse_claims.sh

      - name: Render claims (crossplane beta render)
        run: bash infra/crossplane/claims/tests/render_all.sh

      - name: Run claim bats suite
        run: |
          for f in infra/crossplane/claims/tests/test_*.bats; do
            bats "${f}"
          done
```

Now patch `.github/workflows/pr.yml` to require this job. Locate the `jobs:` block from Phase 8 (which already declared `xp-validate`) and add `xp-claims` as a sibling that depends on it. Replace the closing lines of the existing `jobs:` map with:

```yaml
xp-validate:
  uses: ./.github/workflows/xp-validate.yml

xp-claims:
  needs: xp-validate
  uses: ./.github/workflows/xp-claims.yml
```

## Phase 10 — Terraform modules + per-env stacks (Commit 10)

This commit lands Layer 7 (cloud provisioning) in line with spec Section 9 and Section 1.9. It creates the nine Terraform modules under `infra/terraform/modules/` (contabo, hetzner-cloud, hetzner-robot, ovh, azure, aws, gcp, cloudflare, proxmox), three thin per-env stacks under `infra/terraform/envs/{dev,staging,prod}/`, the OPA/conftest policy bundle at `infra/terraform/policies/`, and the `.github/workflows/terraform.yml` workflow. It depends on Phase 1 (audit-log JSONL appender used by `task bootstrap:apply`) and Phase 2 (Taskfile `bootstrap:*` verbs already scaffolded). The new CI gate is `tf-validate` (Section 13 §13.3) which runs `terraform fmt -check`, `terraform validate`, `tflint`, `tfsec`, `conftest test`, and `terraform plan -lock=false` against mock backends for every env stack.

Module surface is uniform per spec §9.3 (`name_prefix`, `region`, `node_pools`, `private_network_cidr`, `firewall_rules`, `load_balancer`, `managed_k8s`, `managed_db`, `tags` → `nodes`, `kubeconfig`, `lb_endpoint`, `private_network_id`, `state_inputs`). Provider pins follow §9.4 exactly. The contabo module ships as a stub per §16.5.1 (precondition guard against unpublished provider). State backend is profile-driven (Azure Blob default for `p-startup-scale`/`p-enterprise`, R2 S3 for `p-startup-small`/`p-hobby`, `local` for `p-solo`) and rendered into `backend.tf` at `task bootstrap:init` time.

  ```hcl
      "name-prefix"  = var.name_prefix
      "region-label" = var.region
  ```

  ```hcl
  terraform {
    required_version = ">= 1.9, < 2.0"
    required_providers {
      hcloud = {
        source  = "hetznercloud/hcloud"
        version = "~> 1.48"
      }
    }
  }
  ```

  `infra/terraform/modules/hetzner-cloud/variables.tf`:

  ```hcl
  variable "name_prefix" { type = string }
  variable "region" { type = string }
  variable "env" {
    type = string
    validation {
      condition     = contains(["dev", "staging", "prod"], var.env)
      error_message = "env must be dev|staging|prod."
    }
  }
  variable "private_network_cidr" {
    type    = string
    default = "10.50.0.0/24"
  }
  variable "node_pools" {
    type = list(object({
      role  = string
      count = number
      size  = string
      image = string
      disks = list(object({ mount = string, size_gb = number }))
    }))
  }
  variable "firewall_rules" {
    type = list(object({
      direction  = string
      protocol   = string
      port       = string
      source_ips = list(string)
    }))
    default = []
  }
  variable "load_balancer" {
    type = object({
      type      = string
      algorithm = string
    })
    default = null
  }
  variable "managed_k8s" {
    type    = any
    default = null
  }
  variable "managed_db" {
    type    = list(any)
    default = []
  }
  variable "tags" {
    type    = map(string)
    default = {}
  }
  ```

  `infra/terraform/modules/hetzner-cloud/main.tf`:

  ```hcl
  module "shared" {
    source      = "../_shared"
    name_prefix = var.name_prefix
    region      = var.region
    env         = var.env
    tags        = var.tags
  }

  locals {
    cp_pool      = [for p in var.node_pools : p if p.role == "control_plane"][0]
    worker_pool  = [for p in var.node_pools : p if p.role == "worker"][0]
    label_tags   = { for k, v in module.shared.tags : k => v }
    label_string = join(",", [for k, v in local.label_tags : "${k}=${v}"])
  }

  resource "hcloud_network" "this" {
    name     = "${var.name_prefix}-${var.env}-net"
    ip_range = var.private_network_cidr
    labels   = local.label_tags
  }

  resource "hcloud_network_subnet" "this" {
    network_id   = hcloud_network.this.id
    type         = "cloud"
    network_zone = "eu-central"
    ip_range     = var.private_network_cidr
  }

  resource "hcloud_firewall" "this" {
    name   = "${var.name_prefix}-${var.env}-fw"
    labels = local.label_tags

    dynamic "rule" {
      for_each = var.firewall_rules
      content {
        direction  = rule.value.direction
        protocol   = rule.value.protocol
        port       = rule.value.port
        source_ips = rule.value.source_ips
      }
    }
  }

  resource "hcloud_server" "cp" {
    count        = local.cp_pool.count
    name         = "${var.name_prefix}-${var.env}-cp-${count.index + 1}"
    server_type  = local.cp_pool.size
    image        = local.cp_pool.image
    location     = var.region
    firewall_ids = [hcloud_firewall.this.id]
    labels       = merge(local.label_tags, { role = "control_plane" })

    network {
      network_id = hcloud_network.this.id
    }
  }

  resource "hcloud_server" "worker" {
    count        = local.worker_pool.count
    name         = "${var.name_prefix}-${var.env}-wk-${count.index + 1}"
    server_type  = local.worker_pool.size
    image        = local.worker_pool.image
    location     = var.region
    firewall_ids = [hcloud_firewall.this.id]
    labels       = merge(local.label_tags, { role = "worker" })

    network {
      network_id = hcloud_network.this.id
    }
  }

  resource "hcloud_load_balancer" "this" {
    count              = var.load_balancer == null ? 0 : 1
    name               = "${var.name_prefix}-${var.env}-lb"
    load_balancer_type = var.load_balancer.type
    location           = var.region
    algorithm {
      type = var.load_balancer.algorithm
    }
    labels = local.label_tags
  }
  ```

  `infra/terraform/modules/hetzner-cloud/outputs.tf`:

  ```hcl
  output "nodes" {
    value = concat(
      [for s in hcloud_server.cp : {
        name       = s.name
        public_ip  = s.ipv4_address
        private_ip = tolist(s.network)[0].ip
        role       = "control_plane"
        disks      = []
      }],
      [for s in hcloud_server.worker : {
        name       = s.name
        public_ip  = s.ipv4_address
        private_ip = tolist(s.network)[0].ip
        role       = "worker"
        disks      = local.worker_pool.disks
      }],
    )
  }

  output "nodes_schema" {
    value = {
      name       = "string"
      public_ip  = "string"
      private_ip = "string"
      role       = "string"
      disks      = "list(object)"
    }
  }

  output "kubeconfig" {
    value = null
  }

  output "lb_endpoint" {
    value = length(hcloud_load_balancer.this) > 0 ? hcloud_load_balancer.this[0].ipv4 : null
  }

  output "private_network_id" {
    value = hcloud_network.this.id
  }

  output "state_inputs" {
    value = {
      provider = "hetzner-cloud"
      region   = var.region
    }
  }
  ```

  ```hcl
  # UNDER DEVELOPMENT — terraform-provider-contabo is pre-v0.1.0 and not yet
  # published to the Terraform Registry. This module will start working
  # automatically once the provider ships its v0.1.0 release.
  #
  # Track status: https://github.com/shaiknoorullah/terraform-provider-contabo
  # Current fallback for p-hobby / p-startup-small: Hetzner Cloud (hcloud).

  data "external" "provider_check" {
    program = ["${path.module}/scripts/check-provider-published.sh"]
  }

  resource "null_resource" "guard" {
    lifecycle {
      precondition {
        condition     = data.external.provider_check.result.published == "true"
        error_message = <<-EOT
          terraform-provider-contabo is not yet published to the Registry.
          Use the p-hobby or p-startup-small profile with the hcloud fallback,
          or wait for v0.1.0. See providers/README.md.
        EOT
      }
    }
  }
  ```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement the policies and conftest config**

  `infra/terraform/policies/required_tags.rego`:

  ```rego
  package main

  required_tags := {"managed-by", "env"}
  taggable_types := {"hcloud_server", "hcloud_network", "hcloud_firewall", "hcloud_load_balancer", "cloudflare_r2_bucket"}

  deny[msg] {
    rc := input.resource_changes[_]
    taggable_types[rc.type]
    labels := object.get(rc.change.after, "labels", {})
    missing := required_tags - {k | labels[k]}
    count(missing) > 0
    some t
    t := missing[_]
    msg := sprintf("%s is missing required tag %s", [rc.type, t])
  }
  ```

  `infra/terraform/policies/no_open_ssh_in_prod.rego`:

  ```rego
  package main

  env := input.configuration.root_module.variables.env.default

  deny[msg] {
    env == "prod"
    rc := input.resource_changes[_]
    rc.type == "hcloud_firewall"
    rule := rc.change.after.rule[_]
    rule.direction == "in"
    rule.port == "22"
    rule.source_ips[_] == "0.0.0.0/0"
    msg := "open SSH (port 22 from 0.0.0.0/0) is not permitted in prod firewalls"
  }
  ```

  `infra/terraform/policies/state_backend.rego`:

  ```rego
  package main

  # Forbid `local` backend in staging/prod plans. Founders working locally
  # against dev are fine; staging/prod must use remote state.
  deny[msg] {
    env := input.configuration.root_module.variables.env.default
    env != "dev"
    not input.terraform_version
    msg := sprintf("env=%s requires remote state backend (none detected in plan)", [env])
  }
  ```

  ```toml
  output = "stdout"
  ```

  Append at the end of `Taskfile.yml`:

  ```yaml
  tasks:
    terraform:fmt:
      desc: Run terraform fmt across modules + envs (cumulative -check on CI).
      cmds:
        - terraform -chdir=infra/terraform fmt -recursive {{.CLI_ARGS}}

    terraform:validate:
      desc: Run terraform validate against every env stack (no backend init).
      cmds:
        - |
          set -euo pipefail
          for e in dev staging prod; do
            (cd infra/terraform/envs/$e && terraform init -backend=false -input=false >/dev/null && terraform validate -no-color)
          done

    terraform:plan:
      desc: Run terraform plan for the selected ENV against mock backends.
      vars:
        ENV: '{{.ENV | default "dev"}}'
        PROFILE: '{{.PROFILE | default "p-solo"}}'
      cmds:
        - |
          set -euo pipefail
          stack=infra/terraform/envs/{{.ENV}}
          tfvars=profiles/{{.PROFILE}}/terraform.tfvars
          (cd "$stack" && terraform init -backend=false -input=false >/dev/null && terraform plan -lock=false -input=false -no-color -var-file="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/$tfvars" -out=plan.tfplan)

    terraform:apply:
      desc: Run terraform apply for the selected ENV; appends to audit log (Phase 1).
      vars:
        ENV: '{{.ENV | default "dev"}}'
        PROFILE: '{{.PROFILE | default "p-solo"}}'
      cmds:
        - task: terraform:plan
          vars: { ENV: '{{.ENV}}', PROFILE: '{{.PROFILE}}' }
        - |
          set -euo pipefail
          stack=infra/terraform/envs/{{.ENV}}
          (cd "$stack" && terraform apply -input=false -auto-approve plan.tfplan)
          scripts/audit-log-append.sh terraform:apply env={{.ENV}} profile={{.PROFILE}}
  ```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement the workflow and tflint config**

  `infra/terraform/.tflint.hcl`:

  ```hcl
  plugin "terraform" {
    enabled = true
    preset  = "recommended"
  }

  config {
    call_module_type = "all"
    force            = false
  }
  ```

  `.github/workflows/terraform.yml`:

  ```yaml
  name: terraform

  on:
    pull_request:
      paths:
        - 'infra/terraform/**'
        - '.github/workflows/terraform.yml'
    push:
      branches: [main]
      paths:
        - 'infra/terraform/**'
    workflow_dispatch:
      inputs:
        env:
          description: 'Target env (dev|staging|prod)'
          required: true
          default: 'dev'
        profile:
          description: 'Profile id'
          required: true
          default: 'p-solo'

  permissions:
    contents: read
    id-token: write
    pull-requests: write

  jobs:
    tf-validate:
      name: tf-validate
      runs-on: ubuntu-latest
      steps:
        - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        - uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v3
          with:
            terraform_version: '1.9.8'
            terraform_wrapper: false
        - name: terraform fmt -check
          run: terraform -chdir=infra/terraform fmt -check -recursive
        - name: terraform validate per env
          run: |
            set -euo pipefail
            for e in dev staging prod; do
              (cd infra/terraform/envs/$e && terraform init -backend=false -input=false && terraform validate -no-color)
            done
        - uses: terraform-linters/setup-tflint@v4
          with:
            tflint_version: v0.53.0
        - name: tflint
          run: |
            set -euo pipefail
            tflint --init --config=$(pwd)/infra/terraform/.tflint.hcl
            for d in infra/terraform/modules/* infra/terraform/envs/*; do
              [ -d "$d" ] || continue
              tflint --chdir="$d" --config=$(pwd)/infra/terraform/.tflint.hcl
            done
        - uses: aquasecurity/tfsec-action@v1.0.3
          with:
            working_directory: infra/terraform
            soft_fail: false
        - uses: open-policy-agent/conftest-action@v0.1.0
          with:
            files: infra/terraform/envs/dev/plan.tfplan.json
            policy: infra/terraform/policies
        - name: terraform plan (mock backend) for every env
          run: |
            set -euo pipefail
            for e in dev staging prod; do
              (cd infra/terraform/envs/$e \
                && terraform init -backend=false -input=false \
                && terraform plan -lock=false -input=false -no-color \
                    -var-file=terraform.tfvars \
                    -out=plan.tfplan \
                && terraform show -json plan.tfplan > plan.tfplan.json)
            done
        - name: conftest test plans
          run: |
            set -euo pipefail
            for e in dev staging prod; do
              conftest test --policy infra/terraform/policies infra/terraform/envs/$e/plan.tfplan.json
            done

    tf-apply:
      name: tf-apply
      needs: tf-validate
      if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
      runs-on: ubuntu-latest
      environment: ${{ inputs.env }}
      steps:
        - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        - uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v3
          with:
            terraform_version: '1.9.8'
            terraform_wrapper: false
        - name: terraform apply
          env:
            ENV: ${{ inputs.env }}
            PROFILE: ${{ inputs.profile }}
          run: |
            set -euo pipefail
            stack=infra/terraform/envs/$ENV
            (cd "$stack" \
              && terraform init -input=false \
              && terraform apply -input=false -auto-approve \
                  -var-file="$(pwd)/../../../profiles/$PROFILE/terraform.tfvars")
  ```

## Phase 11 — Ansible roles + playbooks (Kubespray-style) (Commit 11)

This commit lands the full Ansible surface described in spec Section 9.7–9.10: `infra/ansible/{inventory,group_vars,host_vars,roles,playbooks}/` with a Kubespray-style group_vars knob set (Section 9.8 table), the Day-1 role catalog (`common`, `container_runtime`, `kubeadm_install`, `kubernetes_join`, `cni_install`, `longhorn_prep`, `wireguard_mesh`, `observability_agents`, `arc_enroll`, `uems_enroll`), the five playbooks (`cluster.yml`, `scale.yml`, `reset.yml`, `upgrade.yml`, `backup.yml`), and the `.github/workflows/ansible.yml` matrix that runs `ansible-lint`, `yamllint`, `ansible-playbook --syntax-check`, and `molecule converge` (Docker driver) for one role per Section 13.3 gate `ansible-validate`. It consumes the Terraform `nodes` output produced by Phase 10 (Commit 10) via `task bootstrap:inventory`, and the secretspec-rendered `vars/secrets.yml` produced by Phase 4 toolchain glue. No host runs are made in CI; molecule scenarios use the `docker` driver against `geerlingguy/docker-debian12-ansible` images so the no-VM portions of `common` and `container_runtime` are exercised without VMs.

```yaml
# infra/ansible/group_vars/all.yml
---
# Kubespray-style knob set — Section 9.8.
# Profile materializer (Section 11) overrides these per profile.

# Cluster-level
kube_version: '1.32.13'
kube_network_plugin: 'calico' # calico | cilium | flannel
container_manager: 'containerd' # containerd | cri-o
etcd_deployment_type: 'stacked' # stacked | external
kube_proxy_mode: 'iptables' # iptables | ipvs
ingress_provider: 'none' # ingress installed via Argo later

# Networking
pod_cidr: '10.244.0.0/16'
service_cidr: '10.96.0.0/12'
cluster_dns_domain: 'cluster.local'

# Extra kubelet / apiserver flags
kubelet_extra_args: {}
apiserver_extra_args: {}
controller_manager_extra_args: {}
scheduler_extra_args: {}

# WireGuard mesh (Section 9.13 forensic borrow)
wireguard_mesh_enabled: false
wireguard_mesh_cidr: '10.50.0.0/24'
wireguard_listen_port: 51820
wireguard_keepalive: 25

# Longhorn prep
longhorn_data_dir: '/var/lib/longhorn'
longhorn_node_label:
  node.longhorn.io/create-default-disk: 'true'
longhorn_fs_type: 'ext4'

# Optional enrollments
arc_enroll_enabled: false
uems_enroll_enabled: false

# Container runtime pins
containerd_version: '1.7.22'
crio_version: '1.32.0'
runc_version: '1.2.1'

# Apt repo pins
kubernetes_apt_repo: 'https://pkgs.k8s.io/core:/stable:/v1.32/deb/'
kubernetes_apt_key_url: 'https://pkgs.k8s.io/core:/stable:/v1.32/deb/Release.key'

# Forensic-borrowed (Section 9.13)
calico_vxlan_crosszone_fix: true
region_label: 'ap-south-1'
```

```yaml
# infra/ansible/group_vars/control_plane.yml
---
control_plane_endpoint: "{{ hostvars[groups['control_plane'][0]]['ansible_host'] }}:6443"
upload_certs: true
certificate_key_lifetime_hours: 2
node_labels:
  node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane: ''
node_taints:
  - 'node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane:NoSchedule'
```

```yaml
# infra/ansible/group_vars/workers.yml
---
longhorn_disk: '/dev/sdb'
node_labels:
  node-role.kubernetes.io/worker: ''
  node.longhorn.io/create-default-disk: 'true'
node_taints: []
```

```yaml
# infra/ansible/group_vars/bastion.yml
---
bastion_user: 'bootstrap'
bastion_ssh_keys: []
bastion_packages:
  - wireguard-tools
  - jq
  - curl
```

```yaml
# infra/ansible/roles/common/tasks/sshd.yml
---
- name: Harden sshd_config
  ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
    path: /etc/ssh/sshd_config
    regexp: '^#?{{ item.key }}'
    line: '{{ item.key }} {{ item.value }}'
    state: present
    validate: '/usr/sbin/sshd -t -f %s'
  loop:
    - { key: 'PermitRootLogin', value: '{{ common_sshd_permit_root_login }}' }
    - { key: 'PasswordAuthentication', value: '{{ common_sshd_password_authentication }}' }
    - { key: 'AllowTcpForwarding', value: '{{ common_sshd_allow_tcp_forwarding }}' }
    - { key: 'MaxAuthTries', value: '{{ common_sshd_max_auth_tries }}' }
  notify: restart sshd
```

```yaml
# infra/ansible/roles/common/tasks/fail2ban.yml

  ansible.builtin.apt:
    name: fail2ban
    state: present
    update_cache: true
    cache_valid_time: 3600

- name: Configure fail2ban sshd jail
  ansible.builtin.copy:
    dest: /etc/fail2ban/jail.d/sshd.local
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: '0644'
    content: |

      enabled = true
      bantime = {{ common_fail2ban_bantime }}
      findtime = {{ common_fail2ban_findtime }}
      maxretry = {{ common_fail2ban_maxretry }}
  notify: restart fail2ban
```

```yaml
# infra/ansible/roles/kubeadm_install/tasks/apt.yml
---
- name: Ensure keyrings directory
  ansible.builtin.file:
    path: /etc/apt/keyrings
    state: directory
    mode: '0755'

- name: Add Kubernetes apt key
  ansible.builtin.get_url:
    url: '{{ kubernetes_apt_key_url }}'
    dest: /etc/apt/keyrings/kubernetes-apt-keyring.asc
    mode: '0644'

- name: Add Kubernetes apt repository
  ansible.builtin.apt_repository:
    repo: 'deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/kubernetes-apt-keyring.asc] {{ kubernetes_apt_repo }} /'
    state: present
    filename: kubernetes

- name: Install kubeadm/kubelet/kubectl
  ansible.builtin.apt:
    name:
      - 'kubeadm={{ kube_version }}-1.1'
      - 'kubelet={{ kube_version }}-1.1'
      - 'kubectl={{ kube_version }}-1.1'
    state: present
    update_cache: true
    allow_change_held_packages: true

- name: Hold kube packages
  ansible.builtin.dpkg_selections:
    name: '{{ item }}'
    selection: hold
  loop:
    - kubeadm
    - kubelet
    - kubectl
```

```yaml
# infra/ansible/roles/kubeadm_install/tasks/init.yml
---
- name: Render kubeadm config
  ansible.builtin.template:
    src: kubeadm-config.yaml.j2
    dest: /etc/kubernetes/kubeadm-config.yaml
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: '0600'
  when: inventory_hostname == groups['control_plane'][0]

- name: Run kubeadm init
  ansible.builtin.command:
    cmd: kubeadm init --config /etc/kubernetes/kubeadm-config.yaml --upload-certs
    creates: /etc/kubernetes/admin.conf
  when: inventory_hostname == groups['control_plane'][0]
  register: kubeadm_init

- name: Set kubeadm_init_done fact on CP0
  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    kubeadm_init_done: true
  when:
    - inventory_hostname == groups['control_plane'][0]
    - kubeadm_init is succeeded
```

```jinja
{% endfor %}

{% endfor %}
---
```

```yaml
  ansible.builtin.import_tasks: token.yml
  tags: [join, token]

- name: Join the cluster

```

```yaml
# infra/ansible/roles/kubernetes_join/tasks/token.yml
---
- name: Create fresh join token on CP0
  ansible.builtin.command:
    cmd: kubeadm token create --print-join-command --ttl 1h
  delegate_to: "{{ groups['control_plane'][0] }}"
  run_once: true
  register: join_cmd
  changed_when: false

- name: Upload certs on CP0 (for extra CPs)
  ansible.builtin.command:
    cmd: kubeadm init phase upload-certs --upload-certs
  delegate_to: "{{ groups['control_plane'][0] }}"
  run_once: true
  register: upload_certs
  changed_when: false
  when: "'control_plane' in group_names"

- name: Extract certificate key
  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    kubeadm_cert_key: "{{ upload_certs.stdout_lines | select('match', '^[a-f0-9]{64}$') | first }}"
  when: "'control_plane' in group_names"
```

```yaml
# infra/ansible/roles/kubernetes_join/tasks/join.yml
---
- name: Join as additional control plane
  ansible.builtin.command:
    cmd: '{{ join_cmd.stdout }} --control-plane --certificate-key {{ kubeadm_cert_key }}'
    creates: /etc/kubernetes/kubelet.conf
  when:
    - "'control_plane' in group_names"
    - inventory_hostname != groups['control_plane'][0]

- name: Join as worker
  ansible.builtin.command:
    cmd: '{{ join_cmd.stdout }}'
    creates: /etc/kubernetes/kubelet.conf
  when: "'workers' in group_names"
```

```yaml
  ansible.builtin.import_tasks: preflight.yml
  tags: [longhorn, preflight]
```

```yaml
# infra/ansible/roles/longhorn_prep/tasks/preflight.yml
---
- name: Gather disk facts
  ansible.builtin.setup:
    gather_subset:
      - '!all'
      - 'hardware'

- name: Compute per-node free GB on longhorn_disk
  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    longhorn_disk_size_gb: >-
      {{ (ansible_devices[longhorn_disk | basename].size | regex_replace(' .*', '') | float) | round(0) }}

- name: Warn on asymmetric per-node free disk (ovh SC-zone-audit forensic borrow)
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: >-
      WARNING: per-node free disk on {{ inventory_hostname }} differs from
      cluster median by more than {{ longhorn_asymmetric_warn_pct }}%.
      Longhorn SC will SPOF on smallest node — audit before bulk I/O.
  when: longhorn_disk_size_gb | float < longhorn_min_free_gb
```

```yaml
# infra/ansible/roles/longhorn_prep/tasks/disk.yml
---
- name: Ensure data dir exists
  ansible.builtin.file:
    path: '{{ longhorn_data_dir }}'
    state: directory
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: '0755'

- name: Format longhorn_disk as ext4
  community.general.filesystem:
    fstype: '{{ longhorn_fs_type }}'
    dev: '{{ longhorn_disk }}'

- name: Discover disk UUID
  ansible.builtin.command:
    cmd: 'blkid -s UUID -o value {{ longhorn_disk }}'
  register: longhorn_uuid
  changed_when: false

- name: Persist mount via fstab using UUID
  ansible.posix.mount:
    path: '{{ longhorn_data_dir }}'
    src: 'UUID={{ longhorn_uuid.stdout }}'
    fstype: '{{ longhorn_fs_type }}'
    opts: 'defaults,noatime'
    state: mounted
```

```yaml
# infra/ansible/roles/longhorn_prep/tasks/label.yml
---
- name: Apply Longhorn node label
  ansible.builtin.command:
    cmd: >-
      kubectl --kubeconfig=/etc/kubernetes/admin.conf label node
      {{ inventory_hostname }}
      {{ item.key }}={{ item.value }} --overwrite
  loop: '{{ longhorn_node_label | dict2items }}'
  delegate_to: "{{ groups['control_plane'][0] }}"
  changed_when: true
```

```yaml
# infra/ansible/roles/wireguard_mesh/meta/main.yml
---
galaxy_info:
  role_name: wireguard_mesh
  author: platform-infra
  description: 'Full-mesh WireGuard between inventory peers (10.50.0.0/24 default)'
  license: Apache-2.0
  min_ansible_version: '2.16'
dependencies: []
```

```yaml
# infra/ansible/roles/wireguard_mesh/defaults/main.yml
---
wireguard_mesh_enabled: false
wireguard_mesh_cidr: '10.50.0.0/24'
wireguard_listen_port: 51820
wireguard_keepalive: 25
wireguard_iface: 'wg0'
wireguard_keys_dir: '/etc/wireguard'
```

```yaml
# infra/ansible/roles/wireguard_mesh/tasks/main.yml
---
- name: Install wireguard-tools
  ansible.builtin.apt:
    name: wireguard-tools
    state: present
    update_cache: true
    cache_valid_time: 3600

- name: Ensure keys dir
  ansible.builtin.file:
    path: '{{ wireguard_keys_dir }}'
    state: directory
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: '0700'

- name: Generate private key if missing
  ansible.builtin.shell: |
    umask 077
    if [ ! -f {{ wireguard_keys_dir }}/privatekey ]; then
      wg genkey > {{ wireguard_keys_dir }}/privatekey
    fi
  args:
    creates: '{{ wireguard_keys_dir }}/privatekey'

- name: Derive public key
  ansible.builtin.shell: |
    wg pubkey < {{ wireguard_keys_dir }}/privatekey > {{ wireguard_keys_dir }}/publickey
  args:
    creates: '{{ wireguard_keys_dir }}/publickey'

- name: Slurp public key
  ansible.builtin.slurp:
    src: '{{ wireguard_keys_dir }}/publickey'
  register: wg_pub

- name: Set wg_public_key fact
  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    wg_public_key: '{{ wg_pub.content | b64decode | trim }}'

- name: Render wg0.conf with peer list from groups['all']
  ansible.builtin.template:
    src: wg0.conf.j2
    dest: /etc/wireguard/{{ wireguard_iface }}.conf
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: '0600'
  notify: restart wireguard

- name: Enable and start wg-quick@wg0
  ansible.builtin.service:
    name: 'wg-quick@{{ wireguard_iface }}'
    enabled: true
    state: started
```

```jinja
# infra/ansible/roles/wireguard_mesh/templates/wg0.conf.j2
# Managed by Ansible role: wireguard_mesh
[Interface]
PrivateKey = {{ lookup('file', wireguard_keys_dir + '/privatekey') }}
Address = {{ hostvars[inventory_hostname].ansible_host }}/24
ListenPort = {{ wireguard_listen_port }}

{% for peer in groups['all'] if peer != inventory_hostname %}
[Peer]
# {{ peer }}
PublicKey = {{ hostvars[peer].wg_public_key }}
AllowedIPs = {{ hostvars[peer].ansible_host }}/32
Endpoint = {{ hostvars[peer].public_ip }}:{{ wireguard_listen_port }}
PersistentKeepalive = {{ wireguard_keepalive }}

{% endfor %}
```

```yaml
---
- name: Install node_exporter via apt (prometheus-node-exporter Debian package)
  ansible.builtin.apt:
    name: prometheus-node-exporter
    state: present
    update_cache: true
    cache_valid_time: 3600

  when: otel_collector_endpoint | length == 0
```

```yaml
# infra/ansible/playbooks/cluster.yml
---
# Section 9.10 cluster.yml — full bringup from bare VMs.

- name: Phase 1 — Host hardening (all nodes)
  hosts: all
  become: true
  roles:
    - role: common

- name: Phase 2 — Container runtime (all nodes)
  hosts: all
  become: true
  roles:
    - role: container_runtime

- name: Phase 3 — kubeadm install + CP0 init
  hosts: control_plane
  become: true
  roles:
    - role: kubeadm_install

- name: Phase 4 — Additional control planes join
  hosts: control_plane
  become: true
  serial: 1
  roles:
    - role: kubernetes_join

- name: Phase 5 — CNI install (delegated to CP0)
  hosts: control_plane
  become: true
  roles:
    - role: cni_install

- name: Phase 6 — Workers join
  hosts: workers
  become: true
  roles:
    - role: kubernetes_join

- name: Phase 7 — Longhorn prep on workers
  hosts: workers
  become: true
  roles:
    - role: longhorn_prep

- name: Phase 8 — WireGuard mesh (when enabled)
  hosts: all
  become: true
  roles:
    - role: wireguard_mesh

- name: Phase 9 — Observability agents
  hosts: all
  become: true
  roles:
    - role: observability_agents
```

```yaml
- name: Install container runtime on new hosts

  become: true
  roles:
    - role: longhorn_prep

- name: Extend WireGuard mesh with delta peers
  hosts: all
  become: true
  roles:
    - role: wireguard_mesh
```

```yaml
# infra/ansible/playbooks/reset.yml
---
# Section 9.10 reset.yml — destructive, requires -e confirm_reset=yes

- name: Guard
  hosts: all
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Refuse to run without confirm_reset=yes
      ansible.builtin.fail:
        msg: 'Pass -e confirm_reset=yes to run reset.yml (destroys etcd, /etc/kubernetes, /var/lib/longhorn)'
      when: confirm_reset is not defined or confirm_reset != "yes"

- name: kubeadm reset all nodes
  hosts: all
  become: true
  tasks:
    - name: Run kubeadm reset
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: kubeadm reset --force
      changed_when: true
      failed_when: false

    - name: Remove /etc/kubernetes
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /etc/kubernetes
        state: absent

    - name: Remove /var/lib/etcd
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /var/lib/etcd
        state: absent

    - name: Remove /var/lib/longhorn
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /var/lib/longhorn
        state: absent

    - name: Flush iptables
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: '{{ item }}'
      loop:
        - 'iptables -F'
        - 'iptables -X'
        - 'iptables -t nat -F'
        - 'iptables -t nat -X'
        - 'iptables -t mangle -F'
        - 'iptables -t mangle -X'
      changed_when: true
      failed_when: false
```

```yaml
# infra/ansible/playbooks/upgrade.yml
---
# Section 9.10 upgrade.yml — rolling CP then workers; uses kubeadm upgrade plan/apply.

- name: Upgrade control plane (one at a time)
  hosts: control_plane
  become: true
  serial: 1
  vars:
    kube_target_version: '{{ kube_version }}'
  tasks:
    - name: Unhold kube packages
      ansible.builtin.dpkg_selections:
        name: '{{ item }}'
        selection: install
      loop: [kubeadm, kubelet, kubectl]

    - name: Install target kubeadm
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name: 'kubeadm={{ kube_target_version }}-1.1'
        state: present
        update_cache: true
        allow_change_held_packages: true

    - name: kubeadm upgrade plan
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: 'kubeadm upgrade plan v{{ kube_target_version }}'
      when: inventory_hostname == groups['control_plane'][0]
      changed_when: false

    - name: kubeadm upgrade apply (CP0 only)
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: 'kubeadm upgrade apply -y v{{ kube_target_version }}'
      when: inventory_hostname == groups['control_plane'][0]
      changed_when: true

    - name: kubeadm upgrade node (additional CPs)
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: 'kubeadm upgrade node'
      when: inventory_hostname != groups['control_plane'][0]
      changed_when: true

    - name: Upgrade kubelet + kubectl
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name:
          - 'kubelet={{ kube_target_version }}-1.1'
          - 'kubectl={{ kube_target_version }}-1.1'
        state: present
        allow_change_held_packages: true

    - name: Re-hold kube packages
      ansible.builtin.dpkg_selections:
        name: '{{ item }}'
        selection: hold
      loop: [kubeadm, kubelet, kubectl]

    - name: Restart kubelet
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: kubelet
        state: restarted

- name: Upgrade workers (respect max_unavailable)
  hosts: workers
  become: true
  serial: "{{ worker_max_unavailable | default('25%') }}"
  tasks:
    - name: Drain node
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >-
          kubectl --kubeconfig=/etc/kubernetes/admin.conf drain
          {{ inventory_hostname }} --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data
      delegate_to: "{{ groups['control_plane'][0] }}"
      changed_when: true

    - name: Unhold + upgrade worker kube packages
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name:
          - 'kubeadm={{ kube_version }}-1.1'
          - 'kubelet={{ kube_version }}-1.1'
          - 'kubectl={{ kube_version }}-1.1'
        state: present
        update_cache: true
        allow_change_held_packages: true

    - name: kubeadm upgrade node on worker
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: 'kubeadm upgrade node'
      changed_when: true

    - name: Restart kubelet on worker
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: kubelet
        state: restarted

    - name: Uncordon node
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >-
          kubectl --kubeconfig=/etc/kubernetes/admin.conf uncordon
          {{ inventory_hostname }}
      delegate_to: "{{ groups['control_plane'][0] }}"
      changed_when: true
```

```yaml
# infra/ansible/playbooks/backup.yml
---
# Section 9.10 backup.yml — etcd snapshot + Longhorn BackupTarget reconcile trigger.

- name: etcd snapshot on CP0
  hosts: control_plane[0]
  become: true
  vars:
    backup_dir: '/var/lib/etcd-backups'
    backup_ts: '{{ ansible_date_time.iso8601_basic_short }}'
  tasks:
    - name: Ensure backup dir
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: '{{ backup_dir }}'
        state: directory
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0700'

    - name: etcdctl snapshot save
      ansible.builtin.shell: |
        ETCDCTL_API=3 etcdctl snapshot save \
          --endpoints=https://127.0.0.1:2379 \
          --cacert=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/ca.crt \
          --cert=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/server.crt \
          --key=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/server.key \
          {{ backup_dir }}/etcd-{{ backup_ts }}.db
      changed_when: true
      register: snap

    - name: Verify snapshot
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: 'etcdutl snapshot status {{ backup_dir }}/etcd-{{ backup_ts }}.db -w table'
      changed_when: false

    - name: Push snapshot to remote (when remote_push_cmd defined)
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: '{{ remote_push_cmd }} {{ backup_dir }}/etcd-{{ backup_ts }}.db'
      when: remote_push_cmd is defined
      changed_when: true

- name: Trigger Longhorn BackupTarget reconcile
  hosts: control_plane[0]
  become: true
  tasks:
    - name: Touch BackupTarget annotation
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >-
          kubectl --kubeconfig=/etc/kubernetes/admin.conf -n longhorn-system
          annotate backuptarget default
          longhorn.io/last-backup-trigger={{ ansible_date_time.iso8601 }}
          --overwrite
      changed_when: true
```

```yaml
# .github/workflows/ansible.yml
---
name: ansible-validate

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'infra/ansible/**'
      - '.github/workflows/ansible.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'infra/ansible/**'
      - '.github/workflows/ansible.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  lint:
    name: ansible-lint + yamllint
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Install lint tools
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install "ansible-core==2.17.6" "ansible-lint==24.10.0" "yamllint==1.35.1"
      - name: Install collections
        working-directory: infra/ansible
        run: ansible-galaxy collection install -r requirements.yml
      - name: Run yamllint
        working-directory: infra/ansible
        run: yamllint -c .yamllint .
      - name: Run ansible-lint
        working-directory: infra/ansible
        run: ansible-lint --profile production -c .ansible-lint roles/ playbooks/

  syntax-check:
    name: ansible-playbook --syntax-check
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Install ansible-core
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install "ansible-core==2.17.6"
      - name: Install collections
        working-directory: infra/ansible
        run: ansible-galaxy collection install -r requirements.yml
      - name: Syntax-check playbooks
        working-directory: infra/ansible
        run: |
          for pb in cluster.yml scale.yml reset.yml upgrade.yml backup.yml; do
            ansible-playbook -i inventory/example.hosts.yml --syntax-check "playbooks/${pb}"
          done

  molecule:
    name: 'molecule converge: ${{ matrix.role }}'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        role: [common]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Install molecule + docker driver
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install "ansible-core==2.17.6" "molecule==24.9.0" \
                      "molecule-plugins[docker]==23.5.3" "docker==7.1.0"
      - name: Install collections
        working-directory: infra/ansible
        run: ansible-galaxy collection install -r requirements.yml
      - name: Run molecule converge
        working-directory: infra/ansible/roles/${{ matrix.role }}
        run: molecule converge
      - name: Run molecule verify
        working-directory: infra/ansible/roles/${{ matrix.role }}
        run: molecule verify
      - name: Run molecule destroy
        if: always()
        working-directory: infra/ansible/roles/${{ matrix.role }}
        run: molecule destroy
```

## Phase 12 — MCP server (Layer 0b) (Commit 12)

This commit lands the agent-facing front door from spec Section 11 (Launcher CLI + MCP server) and the agent-facing Nx Cloud tools from spec Section 3.6. It scaffolds `internal/mcp-server/` as a TypeScript MCP server using `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` over stdio, ships JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12) input/output for every tool listed in Section 1.8 + Section 11.8, implements the deterministic tools (`list_profiles`, `describe_profile`, `recommend_profile`, `list_apps`, `describe_app`, `list_xrds`, `describe_xrd`, `simulate_cost`, `explain_tradeoff`, `nx_cloud_recommend_backend`), and lands well-typed `not_yet_implemented` stubs with stable schemas for the mutating + Nx Cloud read tools per Section 11.8. The CI gate `mcp-validate` (schema validation + contract tests against `packages/contracts/` + deferred-stub conformance) becomes required at this commit. Depends on Commit 2 (`internal/cli/src/core/` underlies `add_app`/`claim_infra` stubs and shares profile/cost code), Commit 3 (`packages/contracts/` for the contract test target), Commit 8 (Crossplane XRDs from `infra/crossplane/xrds/` are what `list_xrds`/`describe_xrd` read), Commit 9 (per-env claims are what `claim_infra` stubs will materialize), and forward references to profiles + cost-price data which land in Commits 13 and 15 — Phase 12 ships test fixtures under `internal/mcp-server/test/fixtures/` so deterministic tools can be exercised before C13/C15 land.

```typescript
// internal/mcp-server/test/schemas/validator.test.ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import { compileSchema, validateOrThrow } from '../../src/schemas/_validator.js'

describe('schema validator', () => {
  const schema = {
    $schema: 'https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema',
    type: 'object',
    required: ['name'],
    properties: { name: { type: 'string', minLength: 1 } },
    additionalProperties: false,
  } as const

  it('accepts a valid payload', () => {
    const validate = compileSchema(schema)
    expect(validate({ name: 'go-hello' })).toBe(true)
  })

  it('rejects a payload missing required keys with structured errors', () => {
    const validate = compileSchema(schema)
    expect(validate({})).toBe(false)
    expect(validate.errors?.[0]?.keyword).toBe('required')
    expect(validate.errors?.[0]?.params).toEqual({ missingProperty: 'name' })
  })

  it('validateOrThrow surfaces the failing JSON pointer', () => {
    expect(() => validateOrThrow(schema, { name: '' }, 'test')).toThrow(
      /test input failed validation at \/name: must NOT have fewer than 1 characters/,
    )
  })
})
```

```typescript
// internal/mcp-server/src/schemas/_validator.ts
import Ajv2020, { type ValidateFunction } from 'ajv/dist/2020.js'
import addFormats from 'ajv-formats'

const ajv = new Ajv2020({ allErrors: true, strict: true, allowUnionTypes: true })
addFormats(ajv)

export function compileSchema<T = unknown>(schema: unknown): ValidateFunction<T> {
  return ajv.compile<T>(schema as object)
}

export function validateOrThrow(schema: unknown, payload: unknown, label: string): void {
  const validate = compileSchema(schema)
  if (validate(payload)) return
  const first = validate.errors?.[0]
  const path = first?.instancePath || '/'
  const message = first?.message ?? 'unknown validation error'
  throw new Error(`${label} input failed validation at ${path}: ${message}`)
}
```

```typescript
// internal/mcp-server/src/schemas/list_profiles.ts
import { PROFILE_ID } from './_common.js'

export const inputSchema = {
  $schema: 'https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema',
  type: 'object',
  properties: {},
  additionalProperties: false,
} as const

export const outputSchema = {
  $schema: 'https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema',
  type: 'object',
  required: ['profiles'],
  properties: {
    profiles: {
      type: 'array',
      items: {
        type: 'object',
        required: ['id', 'name', 'cost_band_usd', 'tagline'],
        properties: {
          id: PROFILE_ID,
          name: { type: 'string' },
          cost_band_usd: {
            type: 'object',
            required: ['min', 'max'],
            properties: {
              min: { type: 'integer', minimum: 0 },
              max: { type: 'integer', minimum: 0 },
            },
          },
          tagline: { type: 'string' },
        },
      },
    },
  },
  additionalProperties: false,
} as const
```

```typescript
  properties: {

    name: { type: 'string' },

      type: 'object',
      required: ['min', 'max'],

        min: { type: 'integer', minimum: 0 },
        max: { type: 'integer', minimum: 0 },
      },

    dimensions: { type: 'object', additionalProperties: true },
    layer_defaults: {
      type: 'object',
```

```typescript
// internal/mcp-server/test/fixtures/fixtures.test.ts
import { readFileSync, readdirSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { parse as parseYaml } from 'yaml'
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'

const FIXTURES = join(__dirname)

describe('test fixtures', () => {
  it('ships exactly the 5 profile fixtures from spec Section 1.5', () => {
    const ids = readdirSync(join(FIXTURES, 'profiles')).sort()
    expect(ids).toEqual(['p-enterprise', 'p-hobby', 'p-solo', 'p-startup-scale', 'p-startup-small'])
  })

  it('every profile.yaml declares id, name, cost_band_usd, dimensions', () => {
    for (const id of readdirSync(join(FIXTURES, 'profiles'))) {
      const doc = parseYaml(readFileSync(join(FIXTURES, 'profiles', id, 'profile.yaml'), 'utf8'))
      expect(doc.id).toBe(id)
      expect(typeof doc.name).toBe('string')
      expect(typeof doc.cost_band_usd.min).toBe('number')
      expect(typeof doc.cost_band_usd.max).toBe('number')
      expect(doc.dimensions).toBeTypeOf('object')
    }
  })

  it('go-hello + py-hello META.yaml fixtures exist and have language', () => {
    for (const name of ['go-hello', 'py-hello']) {
      const doc = parseYaml(readFileSync(join(FIXTURES, 'apps', name, 'META.yaml'), 'utf8'))
      expect(doc.name).toBe(name)
      expect(['go', 'python', 'rust', 'typescript']).toContain(doc.language)
    }
  })

  it('hetzner + grafana-cloud price files are well-formed (spec Section 11.10)', () => {
    const hetzner = parseYaml(
      readFileSync(join(FIXTURES, 'data', 'cloud-prices', 'hetzner.yaml'), 'utf8'),
    )
    expect(hetzner.provider).toBe('hetzner')
    expect(Array.isArray(hetzner.skus)).toBe(true)
    expect(hetzner.skus[0]).toHaveProperty('price_monthly')
  })

  it('rubric.yaml lists all 10 questions from spec Section 11.4', () => {
    const rubric = parseYaml(readFileSync(join(FIXTURES, 'rubric.yaml'), 'utf8'))
    const ids = rubric.questions.map((q: { id: string }) => q.id).sort()
    expect(ids).toEqual([
      'cdn_edge',
      'compliance_floor',
      'env_count',
      'ha_level',
      'observability_depth',
      'registry',
      'secret_backend',
      'target_budget_usd',
      'team_size',
      'workload_shape',
    ])
  })
})
```

```typescript
// internal/mcp-server/src/core/profile-loader.ts
import { readFileSync, readdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { parse as parseYaml } from 'yaml'

export interface ProfileDoc {
  id: 'p-solo' | 'p-hobby' | 'p-startup-small' | 'p-startup-scale' | 'p-enterprise'
  name: string
  tagline: string
  cost_band_usd: { min: number; max: number }
  dimensions: Record<string, unknown>
  layer_defaults: {
    nx: Record<string, unknown>
    helm: Record<string, unknown>
    crossplane: Record<string, unknown>
    terraform: Record<string, unknown>
    ansible: Record<string, unknown>
    secretspec: Record<string, unknown>
  }
}

export function loadProfiles(profilesDir: string): ProfileDoc[] {
  let entries: string[]
  try {
    entries = readdirSync(profilesDir)
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`profile not found: cannot read ${profilesDir}`)
  }
  const docs: ProfileDoc[] = []
  for (const entry of entries) {
    const dir = join(profilesDir, entry)
    if (!statSync(dir).isDirectory()) continue
    const yamlPath = join(dir, 'profile.yaml')
    const raw = readFileSync(yamlPath, 'utf8')
    docs.push(parseYaml(raw) as ProfileDoc)
  }
  docs.sort((a, b) => a.cost_band_usd.min - b.cost_band_usd.min)
  return docs
}

export function loadProfile(profilesDir: string, id: string): ProfileDoc {
  const found = loadProfiles(profilesDir).find((p) => p.id === id)
  if (!found) throw new Error(`profile not found: ${id}`)
  return found
}
```

```typescript
// internal/mcp-server/src/tools/list_profiles.ts
import { loadProfiles } from '../core/profile-loader.js'

export interface Ctx {
  profilesDir: string
}

export interface Output {
  profiles: Array<{
    id: string
    name: string
    cost_band_usd: { min: number; max: number }
    tagline: string
  }>
}

export async function handler(_input: Record<string, never>, ctx: Ctx): Promise<Output> {
  const docs = loadProfiles(ctx.profilesDir)
  return {
    profiles: docs.map((p) => ({
      id: p.id,
      name: p.name,
      cost_band_usd: p.cost_band_usd,
      tagline: p.tagline,
    })),
  }
}
```

```typescript
// internal/mcp-server/src/core/rubric-loader.ts
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { parse as parseYaml } from 'yaml'

export interface Rubric {
  version: string
  questions: Array<{ id: string; weight: number }>
  sha256: string
}

export function loadRubric(path: string): Rubric {
  const raw = readFileSync(path)
  const sha256 = createHash('sha256').update(raw).digest('hex')
  const doc = parseYaml(raw.toString('utf8')) as {
    version: string
    questions: Array<{ id: string; weight: number }>
  }
  return { version: doc.version, questions: doc.questions, sha256 }
}
```

```typescript
// internal/mcp-server/src/tools/recommend_profile.ts
import { loadProfiles, type ProfileDoc } from '../core/profile-loader.js'
import { loadRubric } from '../core/rubric-loader.js'

export interface Input {
  answers: {
    team_size: '1' | '2-5' | '6-20' | '20+'
    env_count: number
    target_budget_usd: number
    compliance_floor: 'none' | 'soc2' | 'hipaa' | 'fedramp'
    workload_shape?: 'stateless-web' | 'batch' | 'streaming' | 'mixed'
    ha_level?: 'best-effort' | 'single-az' | 'multi-az' | 'multi-region'
    observability_depth?: 'logs' | 'logs+metrics' | 'logs+metrics+traces' | '+ebpf'
    secret_backend?: 'keyring' | 'cloud-kms' | 'vault' | 'auto'
    registry?: 'ghcr' | 'cloud-native' | 'harbor' | 'auto'
    cdn_edge?: 'none' | 'cloudflare' | 'cloud-native'
  }
}

export interface Ctx {
  profilesDir: string
  rubricPath: string
}

export interface Ranked {
  profile: ProfileDoc['id']
  score: number
  reasons: string[]
}

export interface Output {
  ranked: Ranked[]
  recommended: ProfileDoc['id']
  rubric_version: string
  rubric_sha256: string
}

const TEAM_FIT: Record<string, Record<ProfileDoc['id'], number>> = {
  '1': {
    'p-solo': 1.0,
    'p-hobby': 0.85,
    'p-startup-small': 0.4,
    'p-startup-scale': 0.1,
    'p-enterprise': 0.0,
  },
  '2-5': {
    'p-solo': 0.2,
    'p-hobby': 0.5,
    'p-startup-small': 1.0,
    'p-startup-scale': 0.5,
    'p-enterprise': 0.1,
  },
  '6-20': {
    'p-solo': 0.0,
    'p-hobby': 0.1,
    'p-startup-small': 0.5,
    'p-startup-scale': 1.0,
    'p-enterprise': 0.6,
  },
  '20+': {
    'p-solo': 0.0,
    'p-hobby': 0.0,
    'p-startup-small': 0.1,
    'p-startup-scale': 0.7,
    'p-enterprise': 1.0,
  },
}

const COMPLIANCE_FIT: Record<string, Record<ProfileDoc['id'], number>> = {
  none: {
    'p-solo': 1.0,
    'p-hobby': 1.0,
    'p-startup-small': 1.0,
    'p-startup-scale': 1.0,
    'p-enterprise': 0.5,
  },
  soc2: {
    'p-solo': 0.0,
    'p-hobby': 0.0,
    'p-startup-small': 0.4,
    'p-startup-scale': 1.0,
    'p-enterprise': 1.0,
  },
  hipaa: {
    'p-solo': 0.0,
    'p-hobby': 0.0,
    'p-startup-small': 0.0,
    'p-startup-scale': 0.6,
    'p-enterprise': 1.0,
  },
  fedramp: {
    'p-solo': 0.0,
    'p-hobby': 0.0,
    'p-startup-small': 0.0,
    'p-startup-scale': 0.2,
    'p-enterprise': 1.0,
  },
}

function budgetFit(budget: number, band: { min: number; max: number }): number {
  if (budget < band.min) return 0
  if (budget > band.max * 5) return 0.2
  if (budget > band.max) return 0.6
  const mid = (band.min + band.max) / 2 || 1
  return Math.max(0.5, 1 - Math.abs(budget - mid) / (band.max - band.min + 1))
}

export async function handler(input: Input, ctx: Ctx): Promise<Output> {
  const rubric = loadRubric(ctx.rubricPath)
  const profiles = loadProfiles(ctx.profilesDir)
  const wTeam = rubric.questions.find((q) => q.id === 'team_size')?.weight ?? 0.2
  const wBudget = rubric.questions.find((q) => q.id === 'target_budget_usd')?.weight ?? 0.25
  const wComp = rubric.questions.find((q) => q.id === 'compliance_floor')?.weight ?? 0.15
  const wEnv = rubric.questions.find((q) => q.id === 'env_count')?.weight ?? 0.1
  const totalW = wTeam + wBudget + wComp + wEnv

  const ranked: Ranked[] = profiles.map((p) => {
    const tFit = TEAM_FIT[input.answers.team_size]![p.id]!
    const cFit = COMPLIANCE_FIT[input.answers.compliance_floor]![p.id]!
    const bFit = budgetFit(input.answers.target_budget_usd, p.cost_band_usd)
    const eFit = Math.max(
      0,
      1 -
        Math.abs(
          input.answers.env_count -
            (p.id === 'p-solo'
              ? 1
              : p.id === 'p-hobby'
                ? 1
                : p.id === 'p-startup-small'
                  ? 3
                  : p.id === 'p-startup-scale'
                    ? 4
                    : 5),
        ) /
          5,
    )
    const score = (tFit * wTeam + bFit * wBudget + cFit * wComp + eFit * wEnv) / totalW
    const reasons: string[] = []
    if (tFit >= 0.8) reasons.push(`team_size=${input.answers.team_size} fits ${p.name}`)
    else if (tFit <= 0.2)
      reasons.push(`team_size=${input.answers.team_size} does not fit ${p.name}`)
    if (bFit >= 0.8)
      reasons.push(
        `budget $${input.answers.target_budget_usd} fits $${p.cost_band_usd.min}-${p.cost_band_usd.max} band`,
      )
    else if (input.answers.target_budget_usd < p.cost_band_usd.min)
      reasons.push(`budget $${input.answers.target_budget_usd} below $${p.cost_band_usd.min} floor`)
    if (cFit >= 0.8)
      reasons.push(`compliance_floor=${input.answers.compliance_floor} fits ${p.name}`)
    return { profile: p.id, score: Number(score.toFixed(2)), reasons }
  })

  ranked.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)
  return {
    ranked,
    recommended: ranked[0]!.profile,
    rubric_version: rubric.version,
    rubric_sha256: rubric.sha256,
  }
}
```

```typescript
// internal/mcp-server/src/core/app-loader.ts
import { existsSync, readFileSync, readdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { parse as parseYaml } from 'yaml'

export interface AppMeta {
  name: string
  language: 'go' | 'python' | 'rust' | 'typescript'
  path: string
  chart: string
  envs: string[]
  capabilities: Record<string, unknown>
}

export function loadApps(appsDir: string): AppMeta[] {
  if (!existsSync(appsDir)) return []
  const out: AppMeta[] = []
  for (const entry of readdirSync(appsDir)) {
    const dir = join(appsDir, entry)
    if (!statSync(dir).isDirectory()) continue
    const meta = join(dir, 'META.yaml')
    if (!existsSync(meta)) continue
    out.push(parseYaml(readFileSync(meta, 'utf8')) as AppMeta)
  }
  out.sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name))
  return out
}

export function loadApp(appsDir: string, name: string): AppMeta {
  const found = loadApps(appsDir).find((a) => a.name === name)
  if (!found) throw new Error(`app not found: ${name}`)
  return found
}
```

```typescript
// internal/mcp-server/src/core/xrd-loader.ts
import { existsSync, readFileSync, readdirSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { parse as parseYaml } from 'yaml'

export interface XrdDoc {
  apiVersion: string
  kind: 'CompositeResourceDefinition'
  metadata: { name: string }
  spec: {
    group: string
    names: { kind: string; plural: string }
    claimNames?: { kind: string; plural: string }
    versions: Array<{
      name: string
      served: boolean
      referenceable: boolean
      schema: { openAPIV3Schema: Record<string, unknown> }
    }>
  }
}

export function loadXrds(xrdsDir: string): XrdDoc[] {
  if (!existsSync(xrdsDir)) return []
  return readdirSync(xrdsDir)
    .filter((f) => f.endsWith('.yaml') || f.endsWith('.yml'))
    .map((f) => parseYaml(readFileSync(join(xrdsDir, f), 'utf8')) as XrdDoc)
    .sort((a, b) => a.metadata.name.localeCompare(b.metadata.name))
}

export function loadXrd(xrdsDir: string, name: string): XrdDoc {
  const found = loadXrds(xrdsDir).find((x) => x.metadata.name === name)
  if (!found) throw new Error(`xrd not found: ${name}`)
  return found
}

export function synthesizeExampleClaim(xrd: XrdDoc): Record<string, unknown> {
  const version = xrd.spec.versions[0]!
  const claimKind = xrd.spec.claimNames?.kind ?? xrd.spec.names.kind
  return {
    apiVersion: `${xrd.spec.group}/${version.name}`,
    kind: claimKind,
    metadata: { name: 'example' },
    spec: {},
  }
}
```

```typescript
// internal/mcp-server/src/tools/list_xrds.ts
import { loadXrds } from '../core/xrd-loader.js'

export interface Ctx {
  xrdsDir: string
}

export interface Output {
  xrds: Array<{ name: string; group: string; kind: string; versions: string[] }>
}

export async function handler(_input: Record<string, never>, ctx: Ctx): Promise<Output> {
  const docs = loadXrds(ctx.xrdsDir)
  return {
    xrds: docs.map((x) => ({
      name: x.metadata.name,
      group: x.spec.group,
      kind: x.spec.names.kind,
      versions: x.spec.versions.map((v) => v.name),
    })),
  }
}
```

```typescript
// internal/mcp-server/src/tools/describe_xrd.ts
import { loadXrd, synthesizeExampleClaim } from '../core/xrd-loader.js'

export interface Input {
  name: string
}

export interface Ctx {
  xrdsDir: string
}

export interface Output {
  name: string
  group: string
  kind: string
  openAPIV3Schema: Record<string, unknown>
  example_claim: Record<string, unknown>
}

export async function handler(input: Input, ctx: Ctx): Promise<Output> {
  const xrd = loadXrd(ctx.xrdsDir, input.name)
  return {
    name: xrd.metadata.name,
    group: xrd.spec.group,
    kind: xrd.spec.names.kind,
    openAPIV3Schema: xrd.spec.versions[0]!.schema.openAPIV3Schema,
    example_claim: synthesizeExampleClaim(xrd),
  }
}
```

```typescript
// internal/mcp-server/src/core/cost-prices.ts
import { readFileSync, readdirSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { parse as parseYaml } from 'yaml'

export interface Sku {
  id: string
  vcpu?: number
  ram_gb?: number
  disk_gb?: number
  price_monthly: number
  egress_tb_included?: number
}

export interface PriceFile {
  provider: string
  currency: 'USD' | 'EUR'
  last_updated: string
  skus: Sku[]
  storage?: Array<{ id: string; unit: string; price: number }>
}

const EUR_TO_USD = 1.08

export function loadPrices(pricesDir: string): Record<string, PriceFile> {
  const files = readdirSync(pricesDir).filter((f) => f.endsWith('.yaml') || f.endsWith('.yml'))
  const map: Record<string, PriceFile> = {}
  for (const f of files) {
    const doc = parseYaml(readFileSync(join(pricesDir, f), 'utf8')) as PriceFile
    map[doc.provider] = doc
  }
  return map
}

export function toUsd(price: number, currency: 'USD' | 'EUR'): number {
  return currency === 'USD' ? price : price * EUR_TO_USD
}

export function latestPricesAsOf(prices: Record<string, PriceFile>): string {
  return (
    Object.values(prices)
      .map((p) => p.last_updated)
      .sort()
      .at(-1) ?? '1970-01-01'
  )
}
```

```typescript
// internal/mcp-server/src/tools/simulate_cost.ts
import { loadProfile, type ProfileDoc } from '../core/profile-loader.js'
import { loadPrices, latestPricesAsOf, toUsd, type PriceFile } from '../core/cost-prices.js'

export interface Input {
  profile: ProfileDoc['id']
  overrides?: { compute_nodes?: number; storage_gb?: number; egress_tb?: number }
}

export interface Ctx {
  profilesDir: string
  pricesDir: string
}

interface Sizing {
  compute_nodes: number
  compute_sku: string
  storage_gb: number
  egress_tb: number
  observability_provider: string | null
}

const SIZING: Record<ProfileDoc['id'], Sizing> = {
  'p-solo': {
    compute_nodes: 0,
    compute_sku: 'cx22',
    storage_gb: 0,
    egress_tb: 0,
    observability_provider: null,
  },
  'p-hobby': {
    compute_nodes: 1,
    compute_sku: 'cx22',
    storage_gb: 40,
    egress_tb: 1,
    observability_provider: null,
  },
  'p-startup-small': {
    compute_nodes: 3,
    compute_sku: 'cx32',
    storage_gb: 100,
    egress_tb: 1,
    observability_provider: 'grafana-cloud',
  },
  'p-startup-scale': {
    compute_nodes: 6,
    compute_sku: 'cx32',
    storage_gb: 500,
    egress_tb: 5,
    observability_provider: 'grafana-cloud',
  },
  'p-enterprise': {
    compute_nodes: 12,
    compute_sku: 'cx32',
    storage_gb: 2000,
    egress_tb: 20,
    observability_provider: 'grafana-cloud',
  },
}

function findSku(price: PriceFile, id: string): { price_monthly: number } {
  const sku = price.skus.find((s) => s.id === id)
  if (!sku) throw new Error(`sku not found in ${price.provider}: ${id}`)
  return sku
}

export async function handler(
  input: Input,
  ctx: Ctx,
): Promise<{
  profile: ProfileDoc['id']
  monthly_total_usd: number
  by_layer: {
    compute: number
    storage: number
    egress: number
    registry: number
    secrets: number
    observability_saas: number
  }
  by_provider: Record<string, number>
  assumptions: string[]
  prices_as_of: string
}> {
  const profile = loadProfile(ctx.profilesDir, input.profile)
  const prices = loadPrices(ctx.pricesDir)
  const sizing = SIZING[profile.id]
  const compute_nodes = input.overrides?.compute_nodes ?? sizing.compute_nodes
  const storage_gb = input.overrides?.storage_gb ?? sizing.storage_gb
  const egress_tb = input.overrides?.egress_tb ?? sizing.egress_tb

  const by_provider: Record<string, number> = {}
  const hetzner = prices['hetzner']
  let compute_usd = 0
  let storage_usd = 0
  if (hetzner && compute_nodes > 0) {
    const sku = findSku(hetzner, sizing.compute_sku)
    compute_usd = toUsd(sku.price_monthly * compute_nodes, hetzner.currency)
    by_provider['hetzner'] = (by_provider['hetzner'] ?? 0) + compute_usd
    const storage = hetzner.storage?.[0]
    if (storage && storage_gb > 0) {
      storage_usd = toUsd(storage.price * storage_gb, hetzner.currency)
      by_provider['hetzner'] += storage_usd
    }
  }

  const egress_usd = egress_tb * 0
  const registry_usd = 0
  const secrets_usd = 0

  let observability_usd = 0
  if (sizing.observability_provider) {
    const obs = prices[sizing.observability_provider]
    if (obs) {
      const sku = obs.skus[0]!
      observability_usd = toUsd(sku.price_monthly, obs.currency)
      by_provider[sizing.observability_provider] =
        (by_provider[sizing.observability_provider] ?? 0) + observability_usd
    }
  }

  const total =
    compute_usd + storage_usd + egress_usd + registry_usd + secrets_usd + observability_usd

  return {
    profile: profile.id,
    monthly_total_usd: Math.round(total),
    by_layer: {
      compute: Math.round(compute_usd),
      storage: Math.round(storage_usd),
      egress: Math.round(egress_usd),
      registry: Math.round(registry_usd),
      secrets: Math.round(secrets_usd),
      observability_saas: Math.round(observability_usd),
    },
    by_provider: Object.fromEntries(
      Object.entries(by_provider).map(([k, v]) => [k, Math.round(v)]),
    ),
    assumptions: [
      `${compute_nodes}x ${sizing.compute_sku}`,
      `${storage_gb}GB longhorn replicated`,
      `${egress_tb}TB egress`,
      'GHCR free tier',
    ],
    prices_as_of: latestPricesAsOf(prices),
  }
}
```

```typescript
// internal/mcp-server/src/tools/explain_tradeoff.ts
import { loadProfile, type ProfileDoc } from '../core/profile-loader.js'
import { handler as simulateCost } from './simulate_cost.js'

export interface Input {
  from: ProfileDoc['id']
  to: ProfileDoc['id']
}

export interface Ctx {
  profilesDir: string
  pricesDir: string
}

type Layer =
  | 'nx'
  | 'helm'
  | 'crossplane'
  | 'terraform'
  | 'ansible'
  | 'secretspec'
  | 'registry'
  | 'observability'

const COMPARABLE_LAYERS: Array<Exclude<Layer, 'registry' | 'observability'>> = [
  'nx',
  'helm',
  'crossplane',
  'terraform',
  'ansible',
  'secretspec',
]

export async function handler(
  input: Input,
  ctx: Ctx,
): Promise<{
  from: ProfileDoc['id']
  to: ProfileDoc['id']
  cost_delta_usd: number
  changes: Array<{ layer: Layer; before: string; after: string }>
}> {
  const a = loadProfile(ctx.profilesDir, input.from)
  const b = loadProfile(ctx.profilesDir, input.to)
  const costA = await simulateCost({ profile: a.id }, ctx)
  const costB = await simulateCost({ profile: b.id }, ctx)
  const changes: Array<{ layer: Layer; before: string; after: string }> = []
  for (const layer of COMPARABLE_LAYERS) {
    const before = JSON.stringify(a.layer_defaults[layer])
    const after = JSON.stringify(b.layer_defaults[layer])
    if (before !== after) changes.push({ layer, before, after })
  }
  return {
    from: a.id,
    to: b.id,
    cost_delta_usd: costB.monthly_total_usd - costA.monthly_total_usd,
    changes,
  }
}
```
